allow_large: The owner allowed it on 2026-09-28: each extra file is a one-line switch of CI and forge.toml to the new dev group
done_when: uv sync installs a declared dev dependency group with the test tools, uv run pytest runs the suite, CI installs the same group instead of adding tools at run time, and the README has a short Contributing section: clone, uv sync, uv run pytest, and fixes go through Forge

findings.body: The new test only exports the explicitly selected dev group; it never installs that group or invokes the documented test command. For example, disabling default groups would leave this test and CI's explicit `--group dev` commands passing while breaking the contributor workflow. Add an integration test using an isolated checkout/environment that runs plain `uv sync`, verifies the installed test tools, and exercises `uv run pytest`, with recursion prevented. The required end-to-end proof is currently missing.
findings.title: Not done: a fresh checkout installs test tools with uv sync and runs tests with uv run pytest

why: A developer who clones symphony-forge to fix a bug gets no test tools from uv sync and no instructions: CI adds pytest at run time and the README only covers using Forge
